data.name: Diamond Resilience
data.description: By spending 1 ki point as a swift action, the monk gains DR 2/-. At 16th level, the damage reduction increases to 4/-. At 19th level, it increases to DR 6/-. This DR lasts for 1 minute. A monk must be at least 12th level before selecting this ki power.
